title.en: I pay homage to my King

fragments.text: אַנְסִיכָה מַלְכִּי. לְפָנָיו בְּהִתְהַלְּכִי. אָמְצוֹ בְּהַמְלִיכִי. יֶאֱזוֹר עֹז וְיִמְלוֹךְ: אֱלִיל בְּהַשְׁלִיכִי. לִפְנֵי בּוֹא יוֹם מַלְכִּי. אִישׁ מַלְאָכִי יִשְׁלַח, וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ: בְּבוֹאוֹ לַהֲלוֹךְ. נְתוֹשׁ חָנֵף מִמְּלוֹךְ. בֵּית גֵּאִים בְּלִי מְלוֹךְ. יִסַּח לְבַל יִמְלֹךְ: בְּתוֹכִי יַהֲלוֹךְ. בְּהוֹפִיעוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ. בְּמַלְכוּתוֹ אֶמְלוֹךְ. וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ: גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכוֹת. בְּמַגְּרוֹ מַמְלָכוֹת. גּוֹיִם וּמַמְלָכוֹת. יָהוֹם וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ: גִּלְיוֹן הֲלִיכוֹת. וְסֵפֶר תַּהֲלוּכוֹת. גַּל הַיּוֹם לִזְכּוֹת. חוֹכָיו לִמְלוֹךְ:

דּוֹרֶכֶת נְסִיכוּת. בְּחִנּוּן קוֹל בָּכוּת. דִּבְּרָה אֲנִי בְּמַלְכוּת. וּמִי יוּכַל לִמְלוֹךְ: דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ נְמִיכוּת. מְחַפְּשֵׂי בְּיוֹם דִּין זְכוּת. דָּשָׁה בְּעֹל מַלְכוּת. עַד צוּר יִמְלֹךְ: הִלּוּךְ מַהֲלָךְ. חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הִלַּךְ. הָדוּר עַד הָמְלַךְ. בְּעֻזּוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ: הַבֵּל הַמָּמְלָךְ. עַל מֶה מָלָךְ. הֲלֹא בְּמִי נִמְלָךְ. כִּי אָץ לִמְלוֹךְ: וּמִלִּפְנֵי מְלֹךְ מֶלֶךְ. חַי מִלְּפָנִים מֶלֶךְ. וְעַד תִּכֶל כָּל מֶלֶךְ. הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ: וּמַה יָעֹז מֹלֶךְ. בְּעֹז מִשְׁפַּט מֶלֶךְ. וְכַעֲבוֹר סוּפָה כְּהֵלֶךְ. יַחֲלוֹף מִמְּלוֹךְ: זָךְ דִּין בְּעָרְכוֹ. יֹאחֵז דַּרְכּוֹ. זֵדִים בְּדָרְכוֹ. נָקָם יַעַט וְיִמְלֹךְ:

זֵר בְּשַׁלְּכוֹ. יִתֵּן עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ. זַכִּים בְּהַמְלִיכוֹ. עַל כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ: חִדְּשׁוּ מְלוּכָה. כַּדָּת וְכַהֲלָכָה. חֹטֶר מַמְלָכָה. בְּמִישׁוֹר יִמְלֹךְ: חֹבֵשׁ אֲרוּכָה. וְאֹרֶךְ יוֹם מְבוּכָה. חֲתֻלָּה לְמַכָּה. יַעַל בְּעֵת יִמְלֹךְ: טֹרַח מַלְכֻיּוֹת. עוֹבְדֵי מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת. טִמְּאוּ חֶמֶד שְׂכִיּוֹת. בְּגַאֲוָה לִמְלוֹךְ: טֹהַר זָכִיּוֹת. וְשַׁאַג קוֹל בְּכִיּוֹת. טֶבַע צוּל דָּכְיוֹת. יִפֶן וּבָם יִמְלֹךְ: יָהַב מַשְׁלִיכִים. עָלָיו בְּנֵי מְלָכִים. יוֹם זֶה לוֹ מְחַכִּים. בּוֹ יָבֹא לִמְלוֹךְ: יַעַבְרוּ מִתְהַלְּכִים. לְפָנָיו כְּמַלְאָכִים. יַחַד מַמְלִיכִים. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: כִּתִּים בְּכַתְּתוֹ. אִיִּים בְּהַכֹּתוֹ. כֵּס מַמְלַכְתּוֹ.

יִכּוֹן וְיִמְלֹךְ: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ. וְקָדוֹשׁ הֲלִיכָתוֹ. בְּגָמְרוֹ מְלַאכְתּוֹ. לְעֵין כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ: לְכָל גֹּבַהּ יַפִּיל. וְהַר וָגֶבַע יַשְׁפִּיל. לְכָל אוֹם יַאְפִּיל. וּכְאוֹר זָרוּעַ יִמְלֹךְ: לְרָאִי יַקְפִּיל. וַחֲדָשִׁים יַכְפִּיל. לְיוֹם זֶה פּוּר הִפִּיל. מִצִּיּוֹן לִמְלוֹךְ: מָטוּ גוֹיִם. הָמוּ גֵּאִים. מָעֲדוּ מִתְגָּאִים. גֵּאֶה בְּבֹאוֹ לִמְלוֹךְ: מָלְכוּ דְגוּיִם. נִטְּלוּ סְגוּיִם. מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם. עֵת אָתָא לִמְלוֹךְ: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים. יֵאָסְפוּ מֵעַמִּים. נְשׂוֹא מְעֻטֵּי עַמִּים. אֶל מְקוֹמָם יִמְלֹךְ: נִגּוּן נְעִימִים. לְמוּלָם מַנְעִימִים. נְשָׂאָם מֵעֲמָמִים. עֲלֵיהֶם לִמְלוֹךְ: סִכּוּת אֱלִילִים. כִּיּוּן

גִּלּוּלִים. סָחוֹב כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים. יָשְׁלְכוּ בְּלִי לִמְלוֹךְ: סוֹד אֵל אֵלִים. הָבוּ בְּנֵי אֵלִים. שְׂאוּ זִמְרָה וְהִלּוּלִים. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: עִזּוּז יָד בְּהַשִּׂיאוֹ. לְהָרִים נְשִׂיאוֹ. עֲמֻסָיו בְּנַשְּׂאוֹ. יָעֹז וְיִמְלֹךְ: עַל רוּם מַשָּׂאוֹ. יָדֵיהוּ בְּנָשְׂאוֹ. עַל הוֹד כִּסְאוֹ. יֵשֵׁב וְיִמְלֹךְ: פּוּר תְּפוֹרֵר אֶרֶץ. בְּכִלָּיוֹן וְחֶרֶץ. פַּח בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ. יַרְגִּיז וְיִמְלֹךְ: פַּחַד שׁוֹפְרוֹת עֶרֶץ. יְשַׁלֵּשׁ וּבָם יִרֶץ. פְּאֵר מִכְּנַף הָאָרֶץ. יַעֲלוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: צְבִי מֵהֲדֹם יַעַל. וְאֶדֶר מִשַּׁעַל. צַהַל מִשְּׁמֵי מַעַל. יְרַנְּנוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: צְבָאוֹת כָּל פֹּעַל. לְצַלְעָם יַרְמֵי תַּעַל. צְפִירַת פְּאֵר לְהַעַל. הֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלֹךְ: קְצִינִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ. אַדֶּרֶת יַשְׁלִיכוּ.

קוֹל יִתְּנוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: קְרוּאִים יִמְלוֹכוּ. וְאַחֲרָיו יַהֲלוֹכוּ. קוֹמְמִיּוּת יֵלֵכוּ. וּבְרֹאשָׁם יִמְלֹךְ: רָז הַמְּכֻמָּן. לְיוֹם זֶה מְזֻמָּן. רָשׁוּם לְמוֹעֵד וּזְמַן. וּבוֹ נוֹקֵם יִמְלֹךְ: רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן. בְּבֹאוֹ מִתֵּימָן. רוּחַ יַסְעִיר כְּתֵימָן. בְּגִלְעָד יִמְלֹךְ: שִׁנְאַן עֲלִיּוֹת. וְסוֹד פְּלִיאִיּוֹת. שִׁיר מִתְלוּלִיּוֹת. יִפְצְחוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: שְׁאִיּוֹת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת. וְהוֹד אוֹתִיּוֹת. שְׁאוֹן הֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת. יָרִיעוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: תְּכַן כֵּס כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. שְׁמוֹ לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ. תָּאֳרוֹ כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. בְּמָלְכוֹ יִמְלֹךְ:
תּוֹמֵךְ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ. וְעַד מְבוֹאַת שֶׁמֶשׁ. תַּמָּה בָּרָה כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. יְרוֹמֵם וְיִמְלֹךְ:

I pay homage to my King, when I walk before Him, I praise His royal might, how He girds Himself with strength and reigns. When I cast away vanity, before the arrival of my king (the anointed) He will send the herald of my salvation (Elijah), and then will He reign. On his approach, falsehood will cease to reign, the house of the proud will not reign, it will be destroyed so that it can no more reign. He will walk in my midst, when he appears in order to reign, through his kingdom will I reign and then will He reign. The owners of kingdoms, when He shatters kingdoms, both nations and kingdoms will He confound and then reign. The scroll of the world’s paths, the book of the ways of life,

open this day for the merit of those who wait for Him to reign. She with the princely tread, when the sound of (Esau’s) tears implored, said: ‘the kingdom is mine, who else can then reign?’ The lowly and humble who seek for merit on the day of judgment, are bowed by the yoke of the kingdom until the Rock shall reign. There is wandering here and there on a way of five hundred years until in glory is He crowned and in His might shall He reign. As to Bel set on a throne, over what does he reign? Through whom was he crowned that he has hastened to reign? Before any king ruled, the Everlasting was king; and when all kings cease, He alone will reign. What might has Molech before the might of the King’s judgment? When a whirlwind sweeps by him, he ceases to reign. The Pure One arranges justice and holds fast to His way, when He treads down the proud, He wears vengeance

and reigns. When He casts down the garland of the proud, He will give power to His appointed king, when He crowns the pure over all will He reign. He renews the realm according to faith and law that the royal offspring may in equity reign. He soothes in healing after the long time of trouble, He will bandage the wound at the time when He will reign. The oppression of the kingdoms, worshippers of images, they have defiled the most precious sights in their pride to reign. To the purity of merits, the roar of the sound of weeping of those cast into the raging floods the Lord will turn, and over them will He reign. Upon Him the royal princes (Israel) lay their burden, on this day do they wait for Him that on it He will come to reign. They pass while walking before Him like angels, paying homage in unison: ‘The Lord will reign’. When He crushes the Kittim, when He smites the islands, the throne of His kingdom will be established and

He will reign. The glory of His kingdom, the holiness of His course, will be apparent to all when He completes His work and will reign. He will fold up the skies and unfold new skies on the day appointed by lot for Him from Zion to reign. The nations falter, the proud clamour, the arrogant fall when the exalted One comes to reign. Then those compared to the fish of the sea (Israel) shall rule, their multitude will be raised up when the King of nations comes forth to reign. The noblest of the peoples shall be gathered from among the peoples to bring the smallest of peoples to their place where He will reign. They will chant pleasant songs before them whom He has lifted up from among the peoples so that over them He may reign. The idols of Sikkut, the abominations

of Kiyun, are dragged along as if slain, they are cast down so that they may not reign. O assembly of the Supreme God, do homage, you sons of the powerful (forefathers), offer singing and praise to the Lord for He will reign. When He lifts His strong hand to raise up His prince and exalts those He has carried, He will be powerful and reign. When He raises His hand above the high heavens, on the splendour of His throne He will be seated and reign. The earth is shaken by destruction and ruin, in which dwellers on earth will be ensnared when He will rage and reign. Three times will He make sound the dread of powerful Shofar blasts and them will He favour, they will cause glory to rise from the end of the earth, for He will reign. Beauty from the earth will ascend and glory from the sea, exultation from the heavens above, they will all rejoice when He will reign. To the hosts of all creatures He brings remedy for their defects, aloud will they praise His glory: Behold in justice does He reign. The princes

who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign. Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign. The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign. The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign. The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign. The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign. Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God’s realm will He reign.
He who from sunrise to sunset sustains the flawless people that is bright as the sun (Israel), will exalt and reign.

אֲהַלְלָה אֱלֹהַי. אָשִׁירָה עֻזּוֹ. אֲסַפְּרָה כְבוֹדוֹ. אֲאַפְּדֶנּוּ מְלוּכָה: אֲשַׂגֵּב לְפוֹעֵל. אֲשֶׁר שָׂח וּפָעַל. אֲנַוֵּהוּ. כִּי לוֹ יָאֲתָה מְלוּכָה: בְּעֻזּוֹ נֶצַח אֲשַׁנֵּן. כִּי צְבָאוֹ אָנִי. וְלִי נָאֶה שִׂיחַ. גֹּדֶל הַמְּלוּכָה: בְּקָהָל אֲבַשֵּׂר. בְּרֹב עָם אֲדַבֵּר. לְמִי שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז. וּלְמִי הַמְּלוּכָה: גּוֹשׁוּ גוֹיִם. וּבֹאוּ מַמְלָכוֹת. רְאוּ מַה נֶהְדָּר. בְּמֵצַח הַמְּלוּכָה: גַּדְּלוּהוּ אִתִּי. וּנְרוֹמְמֶנְהוּ יַחַד. וְאַל תִּתְגָּאוּ. בְּנֵזֶר הַמְּלוּכָה: דְּרָכִים בְּעֵת. נֶעֶשְׂתָה מְצוּלָה. הִתְבּוֹנְנוּ יַחַד. לְמִי נִזְרְקָה מְלוּכָה: דָּרַךְ סוּס בַּיָּם. כְּנֶגֶד שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב. וּמַה יוֹעִיל גֶּבֶר. עֹז בִּמְלוּכָה: הֶאֱזִינוּ רוֹזְנִים. אָז וַיִּרְגָּזוּ. הִבִּיטוּ חֲתַת. וּמָאֲסוּ מְלוּכָה: הִגִּידוּ כֹּחוֹ. לְאֻמִּים וְדִבֵּרוּ. לָזֶה יִכָּתֵב. שֵׁם הַמְּלוּכָה: וְנִלְחַם רֵאשִׁית. גּוֹיִם

וְאָבַד. כִּי נִשְׁבַּע חַי. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה: וַיִּלְעַג בְּכָל דּוֹר. כִּי לֹא לָמַד. מִי נִלְחַם בַּיָּם. וְעָטָה מְלוּכָה: זָד עַל אֲדוֹנָיו. עֶבֶד יֹשֵׁב נֶגֶב. בְּזֹאת תִּרְגַּז אֶרֶץ. בִּשְׂאֵת עֶבֶד מְלוּכָה: זֶרַע בְּרוּכִים. הֶחֱרִימוּ אֲרוּרִים. כִּי נָתְנוּ קוֹל. לְאַדִּיר בִּמְלוּכָה: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבָשָׁן. עוֹרְרוּ מִלְחֶמֶת. בְּלִי לָתֵת דֶּרֶךְ. לְצִבְאוֹת מְלוּכָה: חֵילָם נִשְׁמַד. וְאַרְצָם חֻלָּקָה. וּמֵעַל זְרוּעָם. נָפְלָה מְלוּכָה: טָפְשׁוּ בְּנֵי כְנַעַן. כִּי נָכְרִים הֵם. בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי שֵׁם. זֶרַע מְלוּכָה: טְבָחָם בִּן נוּן. עַד פִּנָּה אֶרֶץ. לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית. אֲדוֹן הַמְּלוּכָה: יוֹשְׁבֵי חֲרוֹשֶׁת. אָז הִקְשָׁה לַחַץ. עֲזָרוּהוּ בְּלִי בֶצַע. אַפְסֵי מְלוּכָה: יָהּ נִלְחַם בָּם. צָבָא בְּלִי בֶצַע. כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ שְׁאָר. וְלָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה: כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן. אַשּׁוּר גָּדַל. וְחֵרֵף אוֹרִיד.

כַּבִּיר הַמְּלוּכָה: כְּלִיל אֵשׁ הֲמָמָם. בְּלֵיל שִׁמּוּרִים. וְאָז יָדְעוּ כֹל. כִּי לָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה: לַשַּׁחַת כָּרַע בֵּל. כְּחָשְׁבוֹ עֲלוֹת לַשַּׁחַק. וְסָר מֶנּוּ לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ. וְיָרַד הַמְּלוּכָה: לְכַנּוֹ הוּשַׁב. וְכֹחַ אֵל הִכִּיר. לְמֵרִים וּמַשְׁפִּיל. הִשְׁלִים מְלוּכָה: מְגֹרָה צֹאן לַטֶּבַח. וְנִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִילוֹת. בִּלְבוּשׁ צָעִיר. רֹדֶם הַמְּלוּכָה: מְכוּרֵי בְלֹא הוֹן. פְּדוּיֵי בְלֹא כֶסֶף. סֹלּוּ לְמַטֵּה כַּמַּיִם. לֵב הַמְּלוּכָה: נִמְכְּרוּ יוֹנִים. לִבְנֵי יְוָנִים. וְרִחֲקוּם מֵעַל גְּבוּל מְלוּכָה: נֵאֲרוּ בְּרִית וָדָת. וְהִמְרִידוּ עָם בָּאֵל. וּמֹגְרוּם בְּלֹא כֹחַ. מְכַהֲנֵי מְלוּכָה: שָׂעִיר הֶחֱנִיף. לְהוֹרֵהוּ בְּצֵדוֹ. וַיִּירַשׁ בְּקוֹל בֶּכִי. חֶרֶב וּמְלוּכָה:
שֻׂגַּב חָלָק. הֱיוֹת גְּבִיר לְאֶחָיו. וְעוֹד תִּסּוֹב. לִישֻׁרוּן מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
עֲשֵׂה לְךָ בְּצִיּוֹן. שֵׁם נוֹרָאת. כְּאָז תַּצְלִיחֶנָּה. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה:
עוֹרֵר וְהָקֵץ. מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. וְכוֹנֵן כִּסְאֲךָ. בְּקִרְיַת מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ. יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. הַר צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב:
פְּנֵי מְאוֹר לְבָנָה. וְחַמָּה תַּחְפִּיר. וְיֵבוֹשׁוּ עוֹבְדֵימוֹ. בִּשְׂאֵתְךָ מְלוּכָה:
פָּאֵר עִיר יוֹפִי. לְבָרָה כַּחַמָּה. וְגַלֵּה לְנֶגְדֵּנוּ. כְּבוֹד מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ. וְחָפְרָה הַלְּבָנָה וּבוֹשָׁה הַחַמָּה כִּי מָלַךְ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בְּהַר צִיּוֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽ͏ִם וְנֶגֶד זְקֵנָיו כָּבוֹד:
צִבְאוֹת גְּאוּלֵי צֹעַן. שׁוֹרְרוּ בְּלֵיל חַג. וְהוּא לַיְלָה נִשְׁמַר. לְסַחֵף מְלוּכָה:
צָעֲדוּ בְּמֵי שַׁעַל. צָפוּ בְּרוּחַ שֵׂכֶל. אָנָה יִנָּטְעוּ וִיקַבְּלוּ מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְיָ מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ: וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
קָמְטוּ שַׁעֲרֵי זְבוּל. בֵּית עוֹלָמִים. כִּי מִבֵּינֵימוֹ. שָׁבְתָה מְלוּכָה:
קָדוֹשׁ יָבֹא בָם. לְעֹלָמִים. וְאָז יִשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ. בְּחַדְּשׁוֹ מְלוּכָה:

כַּכָּתוּב שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂעוּ [sic; corr. שְׂאוּ] שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה:
רָבְצָה עֲדִינָה. שָׁקְדָה מֵאַלְמוֹן. כִּי אָרַךְ לָהּ. קֵץ הַמְּלוּכָה:
רִיבוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים. שְׂאוּ אֶדֶר מֵאֱדוֹם. וְשִׁית עַל אָדוֹן. הוֹד הַמְּלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה:
שָׁוְא שָׂנֵא אֵל. וְהוּא עַל לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ. בִּקֵּשׁ אֱמֶת וָאָיִן. וְרָחֲקָה מְלוּכָה:
שַׁדַּי הָסֵר אָוֶן מִצְּבָאֶךָ. וְיָרִיעוּ לְךָ. תְּרוּעַת מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ:
תַּחְגּוֹר גֵּאוּת. תִּתְאַזַּר עֹז. לְבַל יִשְׂתָּרֵר. זָר בִּמְלוּכָה:
תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל. כִּי יְנֻעַר רָשָׁע. וְשָׂם צֶדֶק לְרַגְלָיו. וְיִצְנוֹף מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט:
תִּקּוֹם גּוֹיִם. תּוֹכִיחַ לְאֻמִּים. תִּשְׁבּוֹר מַטֵּה רֶשַׁע. מוֹשֵׁל הַמְּלוּכָה:
תַּחֲלִיף אֱלִילִים. תִּשָּׂגֵב לְבַדֶּךָ. תִּקָּרֵא נֶצַח. יָחִיד בִּמְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

I praise my God, sing of His might, tell of His honour, I crown Him with a kingdom. I will exalt the Creator who spoke and created, I will glorify Him for the kingdom becomes Him. His might shall I ever repeat for I am of His host, and for me it is fitting to speak of the grandeur of the kingdom. In assembly do I proclaim, before a multitude of people do I announce whose is loftiness and might and whose is the kingdom. Approach, O nations, and come, O kingdoms, behold how glorious He is with the diadem of the kingdom. Call Him great with me, together let us exalt Him, do not behave proudly with the crown of the kingdom. When paths were laid through the depths of the sea, they all understood to whom was granted the kingdom. His horse walked through the sea against six hundred chariots of war, what did might avail man against the kingdom. Princes heard and then trembled, they looked around in dread and abdicated their kingdom. Peoples told of His power and said: to Him shall be written the name of the kingdom. The first people (Amalek)

to fight fought and perished, for the Lord had sworn by the throne of the kingdom. Amalek earned shame in every generation since he had not learned who fought at the sea and was clothed in the kingdom. The slave, who lived in the south, presumed against his master, whereupon the earth trembled when the slave took the kingdom. The seed of the blessed (Israel) destroyed the accursed since they raised their voice against Him who is glorious in kingdom. Heshbon and Bashan stirred up war for they would not grant passage to the hosts of the kingdom. Their army was annihilated, their land was divided and their seed was deprived of a kingdom. The Canaanites were foolish for they had been strangers on the soil of the sons of Shem, the seed of the kingdom. The son of Nun slew them until he cleared the land before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the kingdom. The man of Harosheth was hard in oppression, there helped him without pay those far from the kingdom. The Lord fought against them with a Host without payment, may the rest perish likewise and to God be the kingdom. Like the cedar on Lebanon did Assyria grow great and blasphemed: ‘In my might I will bring down the kingdom’. When the ray of fire destroyed them in the night of vigil, then all could perceive

that to God was the kingdom. Bel sank into ruin when he planned to rise to heaven, human reason left him and he descended from the kingdom. When restored to his place, he acknowledged God’s power, to Him who raises and lowers, he delivered the kingdom. Like sheep to the slaughter was it (Israel) to be driven, then was God’s work accomplished by the youngest tribe (Benjamin from whom Esther was descended) through the power of the kingdom. You who were sold without a price (Israel) will be redeemed without silver, prepare the way for Him who turns like water the heart of the kingdom. The doves (Israel) were sold to the Greeks and they banished them from the frontier of the kingdom. Covenant and law were broken, they caused the people to rebel against God, then powerless were they crushed by the priests of the kingdom. The hairy one flattered his father with his venison and through the sound of weeping inherited sword and kingdom. Exalted will be the smooth one, becoming master to his brothers and once again will return to Yeshurun the kingdom.

As it is written in Thy Torah: He was King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel. Make for Thyself in Zion an awe-inspiring name, prosper it as of old with the throne of the kingdom. Arouse and revive the delight of the whole earth (Jerusalem) and establish Thy throne in the city of the kingdom. As it is written in Thy holy words: a beautiful branch, the delight of the whole earth, the mountain of Zion, the stronghold of the North, the city of the great King. The light of the moon and of the sun wilt Thou cause to blush and those who worship them will be put to shame when Thou dost lift up the kingdom. Glorify the city of beauty, that it may be bright as the sun and reveal in front of us the glory of the kingdom. As it is written through Thy prophet: and the moon shall blush and the sun be ashamed, for the Lord of Hosts rules on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and in front of His elders there is glory.

The hosts redeemed from Egypt sang on the night of the feast, this is the night preserved for the devastation of a kingdom; they stepped through the waters of the sea, they looked with a spirit of insight to the place where they were to be planted and receive the kingdom. As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘Thou wilt bring them and plant them upon the mount of Thine inheritance, the site for Thy dwelling which Thou hast made, O Lord, the sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established’. And it was said: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’. Destroyed are the gates of the temple, the House of eternity, for there has ceased from among them the Kingdom. The Holy One will return to them for ever; then will they raise their heads again when He renews the kingdom. As it is written: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, mighty and strong, the Lord, mighty in war’. And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’.

The voluptuous one (Babel) sprawled at ease, she did not fear widowhood, for far from her was the end of the kingdom. Struggle, deliverers, take the royal gown from Edom and adorn the Lord with the splendour of the Kingdom. As it was written through Thy prophet: Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s. God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom. Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy Torah: And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel. The Lord, his God, is with him, and the royal Teruah is within him. Gird Thyself in loftiness, surround Thyself with strength, so that no stranger may rule over the Kingdom.

The world will be firm when the wicked is shaken off, the Lord will set justice beneath Him and put on the crown of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy holy words: The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter. Thou wilt take vengeance on nations, Thou wilt rebuke peoples, Thou wilt break the staff of evil, ruling over the Kingdom. Thou wilt make idols disappear, Thou alone wilt be exalted, Thou wilt be invoked for ever, unique in the Kingdom. As it is written through Thy prophet: The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His name One. And it is written in Thy Torah: Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
